findings.description: UP narrows Gaap claim that the parents were killed all too easily into their being killed without a fight.

contexts.japanese: なら、呆気なく殺されたあんたのお父さんとお母さんからは何をもらったの？
contexts.japanesePS3: なら、呆気なく殺されたあんたのお父さんとお母さんからは何をもらったの？
contexts.MG: "In that case, what did you receive from your parents, who got killed way too easily?

UP.japanese: 「くす、言うわね。……なぁるほど。何度も蹴り倒されて転がされ、それでも立ち上がるのが紗音からもらった強さだと。なら、呆気なく殺されたあんたのお父さんとお母さんからは何をもらったの？　………？」

findings.sourceReading: 呆気なく殺された describes how unceremoniously or easily they were killed, without specifying whether they resisted.
findings.alternative: Without a fight can colloquially convey an effortless outcome, but also asserts absent resistance; originalWH178690 and MG use too easily.
